title: Instagram — Premier IA widest cabin in class
hook: The widest cabin in the light-jet class — by a lot.
body:
You feel it the second you step aboard: more shoulder room, more headroom, less of the small-jet compromise. The Premier IA's cabin cross-section is one of the widest of any light jet.

This 2005 example is low time at roughly 2,835 hours, with Pro Line 21 avionics (IFIS), TAP Blue engines, and a fresh Check 3 — as current as it is comfortable.

Capable, clean, and ready. DM us for the full spec.
cta: DM us for the full spec and status reports.
media_notes: Lead with exterior; cabin shot second if posting a small gallery.
visual_headline: The widest cabin in the light-jet class.
